Remote Sessions & Mentorship

Soul-led pathways for authentic living, spiritual alignment, and holistic transformation

Stay Connected


Guests who visit Saltay Hanalei Bay often share that their time here becomes a turning point in their lives. While visiting Kauai, many immerse themselves in several experiences and day retreats to fully embrace the journey.

For those who wish to continue the momentum once they return home, our Remote Sessions & Mentorship provide a powerful way to stay connected to the work. Through these sessions, you can deepen the insights, integration, and growth that began during your time on the island.

Offerings


  • Soul Essence Mentorship

  • Spirit Vision Session

  • Multidimensional Root Healing

  • Botanical Medicine Apprenticeship

  • Restorative Communication

Aligning Purpose with a Soul-Led Life

01 Soul Essence Mentorship

Soul Essence Mentorship offers a deeply personalized program focused on aligning personal purpose with life strategy, incorporating heart compass desires and spiritual principles for holistic growth. Together we learn to live authentically by reconditioning old lifestyle patterns and creating a sustainable, soul-led life path through 1:1 coaching, personalized assignment plans, spiritual guidance, spirit-led readings, and measured goal outcomes.

Tailored Spiritual Mentorship

1:1 remote mentorship meetings, a custom plan with personal assignments, and assistance seeding your true essence into a sustainable life path that reflects heart-centered living.

Heart Compass Connection

Soul-driven tools to support understanding of authentic energetic desires while illuminating hidden belief systems and reconditioning outdated lifestyle patterns.

Intuitive & Spirit Inspired Strategies

Messages from the unseen realms & Spirit Guides providing insight, healing, and potential life paths that arise from a place of flow — instilling inner peace and somatic emotional resilience.

Holistic Life Path Alignment

Merging soul-level purpose with practical life path strategy for personal growth, entrepreneurship, and humanitarian initiatives through Soul Essence Discovery.

Book Now

A Three-Part Sacred Exchange

02 Spirit Vision Session

A deeply intimate session in which your guides are contacted, their messages carefully received, and then explored together in personal conversation.

How a Spirit Vision Session Works

  1. You share 3–5 personal questions of inquiry that hold meaning for you at this time.
  2. We meditate to connect with your guides and receives messages, delivered as a written list or audio recording.
  3. Messages are shared with you, followed by a scheduled 1-on-1 conversation to explore their meaning together.

03 Multidimensional Root Healing

You meet remotely with Wanda & Opinder, who work alongside your individual guides to review your auric field. Together they allow for etheric healing of Pukas — energetic openings found within the field — restoring wholeness and energetic integrity at the root level.
